verdict.rationale: Wave documents one bulk operation of its own: receipt bulk import, capped at 10 items at a time, with OCR extraction. Pro-plan bank feeds also automatically import, merge and categorize transactions, but that is background automation rather than a user-run bulk action. No bulk edit, delete, or bulk invoice action is documented, and no API surface could be verified for programmatic batch work. Missing for 10: bulk edit/categorize/delete across arbitrary records, bulk actions on invoices or other entities, limits beyond 10 items, a documented programmatic/API batch path, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once

citations.quote: Scan unlimited receipts and bulk import up to 10 at once to save time.
With the Pro Plan, automatically import, merge, and categorize your bank transactions.
